name: Identify and verify customers before doing business
canonical_statement: Before establishing a business relationship (and at risk-based intervals), identify the customer, verify identity from reliable independent sources, identify beneficial owners, and understand the purpose of the relationship.

name: Apply enhanced measures to high-risk relationships
canonical_statement: Where risk is elevated (high-risk third countries, PEPs, complex or unusual patterns), apply enhanced due diligence and enhanced ongoing monitoring proportionate to that risk.

name: Maintain a written business-wide financial-crime risk assessment
canonical_statement: Identify and assess the money-laundering and terrorist-financing risks the business faces across customers, geographies, products, transactions and channels; keep it written, current, and board-owned.

name: Keep compliance records for their statutory periods
canonical_statement: Retain due-diligence records, transaction records and processing-activity records for the mandated retention periods, retrievable on demand, deleted defensibly afterwards.

name: Detect, classify and notify security incidents on the statutory clocks
canonical_statement: Operate a single incident pipeline that detects and classifies personal-data breaches and ICT incidents and notifies the competent authority within the applicable deadlines (72 hours under GDPR; DORA initial/intermediate/final reports).

name: Do not send unsolicited marketing without consent or a lawful exception
canonical_statement: Direct electronic marketing (calls, fax, email, automated systems) requires prior consent or a narrow existing-customer exception, and unsolicited real-time financial promotions are restricted; honour opt-outs immediately.

name: Safeguard client assets and funds
canonical_statement: Segregate client assets and funds from the firm's own, prevent use for own account, place client funds with eligible institutions, and reconcile entitlements regularly.

members.note: MiCA safekeeping of client crypto-assets and funds

name: Designate accountable compliance officers
canonical_statement: Appoint and empower the accountable officers the applicable regimes require (e.g. money-laundering compliance officer, data protection officer), with published contact and management-body ownership.

name: Manage ICT third-party and outsourcing risk
canonical_statement: Keep a register of ICT third-party arrangements, assess concentration risk, contract the mandated provisions for critical providers, and maintain exit strategies.

name: Secure personal data proportionately to risk
canonical_statement: Implement technical and organisational measures appropriate to the processing risk — encryption and pseudonymisation where appropriate, resilience, and regular effectiveness testing.
